preconditions.description: The number of olympiads before the rule was introduced must be between 1 and 500,000.
The number of cities in Berland wishing to host the olympiad must be between 1 and 500,000.
The number of years Misha's mother is interested in must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= m for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each city index in the list of host cities must be between 1 and m.

preconditions.expression: all(n + 1 <= k_i <= 10**18 for k_i in k)
preconditions.description: Each year number Misha's mother is interested in must be between n + 1 and 10^18.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly q integers, each representing the host city for the corresponding year.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= city <= m for city in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each output city index must be between 1 and m.
